_readme: UPark new-hire training — handout manifest. The dashboard reads this file at runtime;
Current package: the 2026-09-21 set in 'new hire 8 weeks training package' (folder name has spaces on purpose — fine).
nothing here needs a code change. Rules:
* 'base' is the folder the handouts live in (under web/public). It may contain spaces.
* 'file' is relative to 'base'. To REPLACE a handout: overwrite the file, same name.
* To ADD a handout: drop the HTML in the folder and add one entry to 'docs'.
* 'key' is PERMANENT — quiz results and mentor sign-offs are stored against it. Never rename;
change 'label' freely. To retire a handout, delete its entry (history stays in the database).
* 'group' picks the shelf: one of the 'groups' keys below. 'mentor' is hidden from engineers.
* 'week' (1-8, optional) is shown as a chip. 'note' (optional) is shown under the label.
* 'quiz': true when the page has a tap-to-answer quiz the dashboard should record. The quiz
must keep the ids qDone / qTot / qRight / qReset, and a multi-document shell must embed
its tabs with iframe.srcdoc (NOT data: URLs, which the dashboard cannot observe).
* 'signoff': false hides the per-handout mentor ticks (Reviewed / Quiz passed). Default true.
